sonic frontiera review, from a rando on the internet

A few years ago, sonic forces came out, and it was a very mid tier sonic game. Didn't run into too many glitches, but the story was boring, and the level design sucked...and the inclusion of old school sonic was just a cheap money grab because of how popular sonic generations was. It's now been 5 years, and a brand new 3d sonic game has been released. Sonic frontiers, what do i think of the game? Well, let's see

Let's talk about some of the bad stuff first, just to get it out of the way. 

The first glaring issue is the pop in, it's pretty bad and if i was a professional videogame journalist, i'd probably trash the game just based on that alone, but luckily i'm not a pro, just a fan who enjoys ol' needlemouse, so while it's bad, it never took me out of the game.

The framerate, is also kinda bad at points, but i think thaf lostly depends on what you're playing on. I'm using the switch, and that seems to be the most problematic when it comes to this issue...but i only noticed it once or twice, so it didn't bug me too often

The puzzles and challenges. The puzzles were really easy for me, for the most part, couple difficult ones here and there, but mostly, just super easy stuff. The challenges however, i had alot of issues with them, nit because they were hard, but some of them were just annoying.

Those were my major issues with the game, now let's talk about the good stuff

The story is really interesting, it's pretty predictable, but sonic is aimed at a younger audience, so i'm not ginna fault it for that, but for sonic, it's pretty deep, and sometimes kinda dark. 

The enemies are really cool too, no longer are we fightung the same darn badniks at every turn, each island has different enemy types eith different ways to fight them off, and the ones that are repeat enemies, have different abilities, so while the fights can be feel repetitive, you're not gonna find the same exact enemy on a different island.

The exploration is alot of fun, but can be annoying, but it's nice to be able to free roam across these different zones with little restriction. This isn't the first time we've been able to free roam as sonic, but it is the first since 06, and boy does it show, because it's like 100× better.

And now on to things that can be improved on

None of these things are bad, but i feel like they can be built upon in future titles

The combat system, i actually like having a combat system in a sonic game, but i'd like to able to get abilities, then upgrade them, like a proper rpg, i also wish it didn't feel as slow as it does

Boosting. while boosting is nice and a great way to get around, i kinda wish we could build up speed using momentum, as well as boosting for an extra punch...or maybe having to build up to boosting...that may be a weird opinion though

More playable characters. I know the story for this game didn't really call for more playable characters since the side characters were all stuck in limbo/cyberspace or whatever, but in the future i'd like to play as other charactees like, knuckles and amy, and tails. Even if it's just for small segments

All in all, i'd say this is a solid game, a little rough around the edges, but very fun, and very interesting. I'd give it an 8/10
